title: Construct every1/j indicator witness with actual class and stationary normalization paid
statement: Choose a growing coordinate i; xi_i(n)+h_i>=n for all H. With C=sum c_i and K=ceil(2c_i), factorial tails give W_n<=|H|2^(ceil(2C)+K-n) for n>=K. Since Z>=w(a)>0, its rational denominator gives a finite explicit N_tail ensuring W_n/Z<=1/2. Take n_j=max(N_flux(j),N_tail) and f_j=1_D(n_j). The exact indicator quotient is <=[1/(2j)]/[1-1/2]=1/j, with positive variance. Polynomial/coefficients, n_j, witness coordinate lengths and evaluation costs are computably bounded in complete network B, FINITE certificate S,log(j+1) and query-state size. This proves a total witness constructor conditional on a valid motif; it gives no universal motif discovery/size bound, motif/character completeness or general positive-gap certificate.
